title: Home node telemetry
description: Topic aquapulse/v1/dev/{home-id}/telemetry · QoS 0 · not retained · every intervalS seconds. QoS 0 is safe because totalL is cumulative: a lost message loses no litres.

totalL.description: Cumulative litres since the meter was installed. Only goes up (FR-01).

flowLpm.description: Flow rate now, in litres per minute. Exactly 0 when the valve is closed (FR-04).

ph.description: Water pH (0 to 14). Normal tap water is 6.5 to 8.5.

valve.description: Valve position reported by the device: moving while the motor turns, fault if it did not reach the requested position.

boot.description: true only on the first telemetry message after a (re)boot
